title: SEEF Sindh Merit-cum-Need Scholarship 2026
short_description: Merit-cum-need scholarship for Sindh-domiciled students pursuing undergraduate and graduate degrees at recognized universities.
description: The Sindh Education Endowment Fund (SEEF) provides financial assistance to talented but economically disadvantaged students domiciled in Sindh. The scholarship covers tuition fees, a monthly stipend of PKR 10,000, and book allowance for the entire duration of the degree program. Applicants must have a minimum CGPA of 3.0/4.0 or 60% marks in their last examination. The program prioritizes students from rural and underprivileged backgrounds.
how_to_apply:
1. Visit the SEEF official website
2. Create an account and fill the online application
3. Upload CNIC/B-Form, domicile, academic transcripts, and income proof
4. Submit before the deadline

title: NAVTTC High-End IT Training Program 2026
short_description: Free 4-6 month advanced IT training in AI, cloud computing, cybersecurity, and full-stack development across Pakistan.
description: NAVTTC's High-End IT Training Program offers free, industry-aligned courses in cutting-edge technology domains. The program is designed for graduates and final-year students looking to build careers in tech. Courses include Artificial Intelligence, Cloud Computing (AWS/Azure), Cybersecurity, Full Stack Web Development, Mobile App Development, and Data Science. Classes are held at partner universities and training centers across major cities. Top performers receive paid internship placements.
how_to_apply:
1. Visit the NAVTTC website and browse available courses
2. Select your preferred course and training center
3. Fill the online application form
4. Upload required documents and submit
5. Appear for the entrance test if shortlisted

title: DigiSkills Freelancing & E-Commerce Training
short_description: Free online courses in freelancing, digital marketing, e-commerce, and IT skills — open to all Pakistanis.
description: DigiSkills is Pakistan's largest freelancing and digital skills training program, launched by the Ministry of IT & Telecom through Ignite and Punjab IT Board. The program offers free online courses covering Freelancing Basics, Digital Marketing, WordPress, SEO, Graphic Design, Video Editing, Amazon/eBay/eCommerce, and QuickBooks. Over 2 million Pakistanis have been trained. Courses are self-paced with video lectures and quizzes. Certificates are awarded upon completion.
how_to_apply:
1. Visit digiskills.pk
2. Sign up with your email
3. Enroll in any available course
4. Complete video lectures and quizzes
5. Receive your certificate upon completion

title: MoRA Overseas Pakistani Scholarship 2026-27
organization: Ministry of Religious Affairs & Interfaith Harmony (MoRA)
short_description: Scholarship for Pakistani students to pursue undergraduate studies at Al-Azhar University, Egypt and other international institutions.
description: The Ministry of Religious Affairs offers scholarships for Pakistani students to study at prestigious international institutions including Al-Azhar University (Egypt), International Islamic University Malaysia, and other partner universities. The scholarship covers tuition fees, monthly living allowance, return airfare, and health insurance. Preference is given to students from underprivileged families and those excelling in religious and academic studies.
how_to_apply:
1. Download application form from MoRA website
2. Fill the form and attach required documents
3. Submit via registered post or hand delivery to MoRA office
4. Appear for interview if shortlisted

title: NED University Professional Industrial Training Program (PITP)
short_description: 6-month industry-focused training for engineering graduates in collaboration with leading Pakistani industries.
description: The NED PITP bridges the gap between academia and industry by offering 6-month hands-on training programs for fresh engineering graduates. Training tracks include Civil Engineering, Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Chemical, Software Engineering, and Project Management. Trainees work on real industry projects under mentorship of senior engineers. A monthly stipend of PKR 25,000 is provided. Successful trainees receive NED certification and potential job placement referrals.
how_to_apply:
1. Visit the NED PITP portal
2. Create a profile and select your training track
3. Upload CV, transcripts, and degree certificate
4. Pass the aptitude test and interview
5. Receive offer letter and join the program

title: Saylani Mass IT Training (SMIT) Program
short_description: Free 1-year IT training covering web/mobile development, AI, and cloud — with job placement support for graduates.
description: Saylani Mass IT Training (SMIT) is one of Pakistan's largest free IT education programs. The 12-month program covers Web & Mobile App Development, Artificial Intelligence, Cloud Native Computing, and UI/UX Design. Classes are held at Saylani campuses across Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, and other cities. The curriculum is industry-aligned with project-based learning. Top performers are connected with partner companies for job placement. Over 100,000 students have graduated from SMIT programs.
location: Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, and other cities
eligibility: Commitment to complete the full 12-month program
how_to_apply:
1. Visit the SMIT registration page or nearest Saylani campus
2. Fill the registration form (online or in person)
3. Bring CNIC, educational certificates, and 2 photos
4. Pass the basic aptitude assessment
5. Attend orientation and begin classes

title: NASTP Internship & Training Program 2026
short_description: Paid internship in aerospace, drone technology, AI/ML, and embedded systems at Pakistan's premier tech park.
description: NASTP offers competitive internship programs for engineering and CS students/graduates in cutting-edge domains. Interns work on real projects in aerospace engineering, unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs/drones), artificial intelligence, machine learning, embedded systems, and IoT. The 3-6 month internship includes a monthly stipend, mentorship from industry experts, and access to NASTP's state-of-the-art labs. Outstanding interns may receive full-time job offers from partner companies.
eligibility: Engineering/CS students (5th semester+) or fresh graduates
how_to_apply:
1. Visit the NASTP careers page
2. Browse available internship positions
3. Apply online with your CV and transcript
4. Complete the technical assessment
5. Attend the panel interview if shortlisted

title: TechDestination Web Development Bootcamp
short_description: Intensive 3-month bootcamp in MERN stack development with live projects and career support in Karachi.
description: TechDestination's Web Development Bootcamp is an intensive program designed to take you from beginner to job-ready MERN stack developer. The curriculum covers HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React.js, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Git, and deployment. Students work on 3+ live projects, participate in code reviews, and receive 1-on-1 career coaching. The program includes mock interviews, portfolio building, and connections with hiring partner companies in Karachi's tech industry.
how_to_apply:
1. Visit techdestination.pk and click 'Apply Now'
2. Fill the application form
3. Take the online aptitude test
4. Attend the selection interview
5. Enroll and pay the course fee (installment plans available)

title: HEC Need-Based Scholarship 2026-27
short_description: Full tuition + monthly stipend for needy students at public sector universities across Pakistan.
description: The HEC Need-Based Scholarship Program supports talented students from low-income families pursuing undergraduate and graduate degrees at HEC-recognized public sector universities. The scholarship covers full tuition fees, a monthly stipend of PKR 15,000, and an annual book/travel allowance. Applicants must demonstrate financial need with a family income below PKR 450,000 per year and maintain a minimum CGPA of 3.0 throughout the program.
how_to_apply:
1. Visit the HEC scholarship portal
2. Create an account on the HEC e-portal
3. Fill the online application and upload documents
4. Submit through your university's financial aid office
5. Await merit list announcement

title: Fulbright Master's Scholarship for Pakistani Students 2027
organization: USEFP (United States Educational Foundation in Pakistan)
short_description: Fully funded master's degree at a US university — tuition, living, airfare, and health insurance included.
description: The Fulbright Master's Scholarship provides full funding for Pakistani nationals to pursue a master's degree at any accredited US university. The award covers tuition and fees, living stipend (approximately $2,000-2,500/month), round-trip airfare, health insurance, and settling-in allowance. Applicants must have a 4-year bachelor's degree (or equivalent) with strong academic record. GRE General Test is required. Preference is given to candidates with community service experience and clear career goals.
stipend: Full tuition + $2,000-2,500/month living + airfare + health insurance
how_to_apply:
1. Visit usefp.org and review eligibility criteria
2. Take the GRE General Test (minimum 145 on each section)
3. Complete the online application with essays
4. Submit 3 recommendation letters
5. Interview if shortlisted

title: Chevening Scholarship Pakistan 2027-28
short_description: Fully funded one-year master's at any UK university — tuition, living, flights, and networking events.
description: Chevening is the UK government's global scholarship programme, funded by the Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office. It offers a fully funded one-year master's degree at any UK university. The award covers full tuition fees, monthly living stipend (£1,300-1,500), economy class return airfare, arrival allowance, and exclusive networking events. Applicants must have 2+ years of work experience and commit to returning to Pakistan for at least 2 years after completion.
eligibility: Return to Pakistan for 2+ years after study
how_to_apply:
1. Visit chevening.org and create an account
2. Complete the online application with 4 essays
3. Apply to 3 UK university courses simultaneously
4. Submit 2 reference letters
5. Interview at British High Commission if shortlisted

title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master's Scholarship 2027
short_description: Fully funded joint master's across multiple European universities — €25,000/year + travel costs.
description: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master Degrees (EMJMD) are prestigious integrated study programmes delivered by consortia of European universities. Pakistani students can apply to 150+ programmes across engineering, sciences, social sciences, arts, and humanities. The scholarship covers full tuition, €25,000 annual participation cost (living expenses), travel costs (€3,000-4,000), and insurance. Students study at 2-4 universities in different European countries over 1-2 years.
eligibility: Bachelor's degree relevant to the programme
Not resided in programme countries for 12+ months in last 3 years
how_to_apply:
1. Browse the Erasmus Mundus Catalogue for programmes
2. Select up to 3 programmes that interest you
3. Apply directly through each programme's website
4. Submit motivation letter, CV, transcripts, and references
5. Interview if shortlisted

title: DAAD Scholarship for Pakistani Students 2027
short_description: Fully funded master's/PhD at German universities — €934/month stipend + tuition waiver + travel allowance.
description: DAAD offers multiple scholarship programmes for Pakistani students to study at German universities. The most relevant for Pakistani applicants is the EPOS (Development-Related Postgraduate Courses) programme. It covers monthly stipend (€934 master's, €1,300 PhD), health insurance, travel allowance, and study/research allowance. German language courses are often included. Programmes are taught in English. Applicants need a relevant bachelor's degree and 2+ years professional experience for EPOS.
eligibility: Bachelor's degree (minimum 2 years since graduation for EPOS)
how_to_apply:
1. Search the DAAD scholarship database for suitable programmes
2. Apply directly to the German university programme
3. Submit a separate DAAD scholarship application
4. Include motivation letter, CV, and research proposal if PhD
5. Interview at German Embassy if shortlisted

title: Punjab IT Board (PITB) Youth Internship Program 2026
short_description: 3-month paid tech internship for Punjab youth at top software companies — PKR 20,000/month stipend.
description: The PITB Youth Internship Program places final-year students and fresh graduates at leading IT companies across Punjab. Interns gain real-world experience in software development, data analytics, cybersecurity, and project management. The 3-month program provides a monthly stipend of PKR 20,000, mentorship from senior professionals, and a completion certificate. Top performers often receive full-time job offers from their host companies. The program runs in Lahore, Faisalabad, Multan, and Rawalpindi.
how_to_apply:
1. Visit the PITB website internship section
2. Register and create your profile
3. Browse available internship positions
4. Apply with your CV and university enrollment/degree
5. Attend the screening test and interview

title: Ignite National Technology Fund — Startup Grant
short_description: Up to PKR 5 million grant for Pakistani tech startups and student innovators with early-stage prototypes.
description: Ignite provides funding for Pakistani entrepreneurs, students, and innovators to develop technology products and startups. The Ignite fellowship/seed fund provides up to PKR 5 million for early-stage technology ventures. The programme covers prototype development, mentorship, legal support, and connections to investors. Applicants must present a technology-driven business idea with market potential. University students and fresh graduates are especially encouraged to apply with innovative solutions.
how_to_apply:
1. Visit ignite.org.pk and review funding categories
2. Prepare a business plan and pitch deck
3. Submit the online application with your proposal
4. Present to the evaluation panel if shortlisted
5. Sign the funding agreement and begin development

title: Google Career Certificates — Pakistan Scholarship
short_description: Free Google professional certificates in Data Analytics, IT Support, Project Management, and UX Design.
description: Google Career Certificates are available to Pakistani learners through partnerships with local organizations and scholarship programmes. Each certificate takes 3-6 months to complete and covers job-ready skills in high-demand fields. Available certificates include Data Analytics, IT Support, Project Management, UX Design, Cybersecurity, and Digital Marketing & E-commerce. No degree or experience required. Graduates gain access to an employer consortium and career resources.
eligibility: No degree or prior experience required
how_to_apply:
1. Visit the Google Career Certificates page for Pakistan
2. Enroll through Coursera (free audit or apply for scholarship)
3. Complete the self-paced online curriculum
4. Pass all assessments and projects
5. Receive your Google certificate and access career resources

title: British Council IELTS Scholarship Pakistan 2026
short_description: Covers full IELTS test fee + preparation course for high-potential Pakistani students applying to study abroad.
description: The British Council IELTS Scholarship supports Pakistani students who demonstrate academic excellence and financial need to take the IELTS test. The award covers the full IELTS test fee (PKR 55,000+), access to official preparation materials, and a pre-departure briefing. Recipients also receive mentorship guidance for their overseas university applications. The scholarship is ideal for students planning to apply to UK, Australian, Canadian, or European universities.
eligibility: Planning to study abroad within 12 months
stipend: Full IELTS test fee + preparation materials
how_to_apply:
1. Visit the British Council Pakistan website
2. Fill the IELTS scholarship application form
3. Upload academic transcripts and proof of university application
4. Write a 500-word essay on your study abroad goals
5. Await results within 4 weeks
requirements: University application proof or offer letter

title: IBA Karachi — Merit Scholarship for BS Programmes
short_description: Merit-based scholarship covering 25-100% tuition for top-performing BS applicants at Pakistan's premier business school.
description: IBA Karachi offers merit-based scholarships to exceptional students admitted to its BS programmes (BBA, BS Computer Science, BS Economics, BS Accounting & Finance). Scholarships range from 25% to 100% tuition coverage based on IBA entry test scores and academic merit. Need-based financial aid is also available for students who demonstrate financial hardship. IBA's BS programmes are 4-year programmes with strong placement records in Pakistan's corporate sector.
how_to_apply:
1. Apply for BS admission at IBA Karachi online
2. Take the IBA admission test
3. Apply for scholarship through the financial aid section
4. Submit income proof and financial documents
5. Scholarship awarded based on merit + need assessment

title: P@SHA Women in Tech Program 2026
short_description: 3-month tech skills training + paid internship exclusively for Pakistani women in IT and software development.
description: P@SHA's Women in Tech programme empowers Pakistani women to enter the IT industry through targeted training and paid internships. The 3-month programme covers web development, mobile app development, UI/UX design, or data analytics — depending on the track chosen. Training is followed by a 3-month paid internship at a P@SHA member company. The programme is designed for women graduates (or final-year students) in any discipline who want to transition into tech careers.
how_to_apply:
1. Visit the P@SHA website and find the Women in Tech section
2. Fill the online application form
3. Take the aptitude assessment
4. Attend the interview
5. Join the training cohort

title: HEC Overseas Scholarship for PhD Studies 2026
short_description: Fully funded PhD at top-200 world universities — tuition, stipend, airfare, and research allowance.
description: The HEC Overseas PhD Scholarship funds Pakistani scholars to pursue doctoral studies at the world's top 200 universities (QS/THE rankings). The award covers full tuition fees, monthly stipend (USD 1,500-2,500 depending on country), return airfare, health insurance, research/conference allowance, and thesis printing costs. Applicants must have a relevant master's degree (18 years education) with a minimum 3.0 CGPA and a strong research proposal.
stipend: Full tuition + USD 1,500-2,500/month + airfare + research allowance
how_to_apply:
1. Visit the HEC overseas scholarship portal
2. Create an account on HEC e-portal
3. Submit research proposal and application
4. Upload all academic documents
5. Appear for HEC Aptitude Test (HAT) and interview

title: Karandaaz Pakistan Youth Business Loan
short_description: Interest-free business loans up to PKR 1.5 million + mentorship for Pakistani youth entrepreneurs aged 21-45.
description: Karandaaz Pakistan, funded by UK Aid, provides interest-free loans and business development support to young Pakistani entrepreneurs. The programme offers loans from PKR 200,000 to PKR 1.5 million for starting or expanding a business. Alongside funding, entrepreneurs receive business training, mentorship from industry experts, and access to Karandaaz's network of partners. The programme targets youth aged 21-45 with viable business plans in any sector.
how_to_apply:
1. Visit karandaaz.pk and review loan products
2. Prepare a business plan and financial projections
3. Submit the online application
4. Attend business assessment and interview
5. Sign the loan agreement and receive disbursement

title: Asia Exchange Scholarship for Pakistani Students 2026
organization: Asia Exchange (with partner universities in South Korea, Thailand, Malaysia)
short_description: 1-semester study abroad at partner Asian universities with partial tuition waiver and cultural immersion.
description: Asia Exchange offers Pakistani students the opportunity to study for one semester at partner universities across South Korea, Thailand, Malaysia, and Indonesia. The programme provides a partial tuition scholarship (30-50% waiver), cultural orientation, and support services. Students earn credits transferable to their home university. Available fields include Business, Engineering, IT, International Relations, and Hospitality. The programme is ideal for students seeking international exposure without a full degree commitment.
how_to_apply:
1. Browse programmes on asiaexchange.org
2. Select your destination university and semester
3. Submit the online application
4. Upload transcript and recommendation from home university
5. Receive admission and prepare for departure

title: UNDP Pakistan Youth Innovation Challenge 2026
short_description: National competition for youth-led solutions to SDG challenges — winners receive PKR 500K-2M grants + UN mentorship.
description: The UNDP Pakistan Youth Innovation Challenge invites young Pakistanis (18-35) to develop innovative solutions addressing Sustainable Development Goals in areas like climate change, education, health, gender equality, and economic empowerment. Winners receive implementation grants ranging from PKR 500,000 to PKR 2,000,000, along with mentorship from UN experts, capacity building workshops, and visibility at national and international forums. The competition includes regional qualifiers and a national finale.
how_to_apply:
1. Visit UNDP Pakistan's website for challenge details
2. Form a team or apply individually
3. Develop your solution concept note (max 5 pages)
4. Submit through the online portal
5. Present at regional qualifier if shortlisted

title: PITB E-Rozgaar Centers — Free Freelancing Training
short_description: Free 3-month freelancing training at 100+ e-Rozgaar centers across Punjab — earn while you learn.
description: E-Rozgaar centers, established by PITB across 100+ locations in Punjab, provide free 3-month training in freelancing and digital skills. The programme covers Content Writing, Digital Marketing, Creative Design, Web Development, and E-commerce. Trainees learn how to create profiles on Upwork, Fiverr, and other platforms, and start earning during the training. Each center provides computer labs, high-speed internet, and experienced trainers. Over 50,000 freelancers have been trained.
how_to_apply:
1. Visit erozgaar.pitb.gov.pk
2. Register and select your nearest center
3. Choose your training track
4. Attend the orientation session
5. Begin training at your assigned center

title: Microsoft Learn Student Ambassadors — Pakistan
short_description: Student leadership programme with Azure credits, event support, certifications, and global networking opportunities.
description: The Microsoft Learn Student Ambassadors programme empowers university students to become tech leaders on their campuses. Ambassadors receive free Azure credits, access to Microsoft Learn resources, Visual Studio Dev Essentials, and LinkedIn Learning. They organize events, lead study groups, and mentor peers. Benefits include free Microsoft certification vouchers, swag, invitation to exclusive global events, and career mentorship. The programme runs for 1 year with potential for renewal.
eligibility: Age 16+ enrolled in a degree programme
stipend: Azure credits + certification vouchers + swag + event support
how_to_apply:
1. Visit the Microsoft Student Ambassadors page
2. Sign in with your Microsoft account
3. Fill the application with your leadership experience
4. Describe how you'll impact your campus community
5. Submit and await review (4-6 weeks)
